endTaper.note: Ø17 reduced shank rising to M20 thread at the 30° right-side shoulder; 2.6 mm axial extent from (20−17)/2/tan30°. Nominal visualization.

sections.note: Nominal right thread span 22 mm; 4 mm rightmost lead-in represented with approximate Ø18 terminal face. Thread hand and tip diameter remain unconfirmed.
